cards.name: Cantankerous Captain
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Then that creature gains menace until end of turn if creatures you control have total power 8 or greater. (It can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)

cards.name: Captain James T. Kirk
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever Captain Kirk enters or attacks, choose one. If you have no cards in hand, choose one or more instead.
• Discard a card, then draw a card.
• Create a 1/1 red Officer creature token.
• Creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Captain Michael Burnham
cards.oracle_text:
Trample
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, Captain Burnham deals 1 damage to each opponent. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Captain Burnham.

cards.name: Captain's Tutelage
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, enchanted creature gains first strike until end of turn.
Enchanted creature gets +2/+0.

cards.name: D-7 Battle Cruiser
cards.oracle_text:
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 8+.)

cards.name: Dahar Master
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice another nonland permanent. When you do, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.

cards.name: Dominion Infiltration
cards.oracle_text: Choose X target creatures your opponents control. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it has changeling. Those tokens gain haste. Exile those tokens at the beginning of the next end step. (They're every creature type.)

cards.name: Encounter the Unknown
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Come in Peace — Exile the top two cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
• Shoot to Kill — Encounter the Unknown deals 2 damage to each creature and each player.

cards.name: Erica Ortegas, Plucky Pilot
cards.oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever Erica Ortegas becomes tapped, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you do, return a land you control to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Exploratory Mission
cards.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a quest counter on this enchantment. Then exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may play that card this turn. If this enchantment has five or more quest counters on it, add {R}{R}.
